generate_commandlines_from_metadata: generate commandlines to create image pairs from metadata JSON files in a directory tree
run_batch_metadata_processing: run the script with --input_dir and --output_dir to batch process all metadata.json files recursively
skip_already_processed_scenes: skip scenes where the output metadata.json already exists to avoid redundant processing
prefix_commandlines_with_env_setup: use the --prefix argument to prepend environment setup commands to each generated commandline
review_metadata_generation_script: review the script that generates commandlines for habitat_sim image pair generation from metadata files
